meta.title: Taking a vendor off the award removes exactly its amount, and putting it back restores it
gaps: The available setup has only one awarded vendor, not three vendors.
The vocabulary has no operation or library case to assert the removed vendor's exact amount or verify that only the other vendors' amounts remain.
The vocabulary has no supported operation to restore the vendor with 5 units and compare the totals with API-EVDAWD-003.
The empty-award value of ₹0 cannot be asserted because proposal allocation totals are not available as read-back fields.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the read succeeds; “proposals” is present.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; “proposals” is present.
